360	Yes, and with his own teeth he circumcised himself.	Sim, e com os próprios dentes ele se circuncidou.

366	Doctor Valach was something, a special mohel.	O doutor Valach era alguém especial, um mohel único.
367	Rav Chaim Toderes told me, his father was called Rav Shmuel Tefilinsky.	Rav Chaim Toderes me contou: o pai dele se chamava Rav Shmuel Tefilinsky.
368	He was the number one diligent scholar, there's none like him, always learning, not a moment wasted.	Era o estudioso mais dedicado, não havia igual, estudava o tempo todo, não perdia um instante.
369	Doctor Valach knew that Rav Shmuel Tefilinsky was a diligent scholar, and it didn't concern him how he comes	O doutor Valach sabia que Rav Shmuel Tefilinsky era dedicado ao estudo, e não lhe importava como ele vem	
370	and when he comes. They set the time, and he's late because he learns all	e quando vem. Marcam o horário, e ele se atrasa porque estuda o	
371	the time. A son was born to him, he has to do the brit milah. Whom	tempo todo. Nasceu-lhe um filho, é preciso fazer o brit milá. Quem	
372	do they invite?	eles convidam?
373	Doctor Valach, that was the mohel. Doctor Valach said to him, listen, you	O doutor Valach, que era o mohel. O doutor Valach disse a ele: escute, você	
374	know that I don't	sabe que eu não

377	I do the milah and I leave it to you like that.	Eu faço a milá e deixo para você assim.

379	But in the end he really was late.	Mas no fim ele de fato se atrasou.

381	Doctor Valach did the milah.	O doutor Valach fez a milá.
382	Afterwards he came, Rav Shmuel Tefilinsky, and says, all I can give you is only the orlah.	Depois ele veio, Rav Shmuel Tefilinsky, e disse: tudo o que posso lhe dar é só o prepúcio.

390	us that his son Shlomo, Rabbi Shlomo, was born	que o filho dele, Shlomo, Rabi Shlomo, nasceu
